55f6043ea5.q: How did Ella Wood transition from law to starting New World Sales after being fired?
55f6043ea5.a: After being fired from her legal assistant role, Ella Wood used her severance to give herself two to three months before looking for another job. She used this time to work intensively on building a sales curriculum with her two business partners whom she had met on Discord. She stayed up for seven days with very minimal sleep writing, filming, and developing the curriculum, which launched about a month later, marking the birth of New World Sales.
55f6043ea5.e: When Getting Fired Opens Doors and Leads to Career Success with Ella Wood
55f6043ea5.rq: I felt like I was chasing a dream that wasn't really mine to begin with—it was more so to prove people wrong based on everything I had heard about getting into law.

42b1cce673.q: What does New World Sales do and how does its placement software work?
42b1cce673.a: New World Sales is a sales training company and staffing agency that helps people launch successful high-ticket sales careers through e-learning and 12 live classes every single week. The company also helps businesses scale by placing sales talent. Their placement software allows companies to search and filter candidates based on time zone and availability, and uniquely, companies can watch recordings of how salespeople sell before they even interview them.

d7ff61e36c.q: Why did Ella Wood originally pursue law school in Australia instead of other careers?
d7ff61e36c.a: Ella Wood got into law because it was the path that everyone around her told her was the career to pursue. She wanted to become a lawyer in high school after her initial childhood dream of becoming an Olympic figure skater ended. In Australia's system, she went straight from high school into law school with high grades, studied law for three to four years, then had to complete practical training to become admitted as a lawyer.

6b11614de3.q: How old was Ella Wood when she first discovered the potential of sales commissions?
6b11614de3.a: When Ella Wood was 18 and working in sales, she saw people on a commission leaderboard earning up to $10,000 in commissions simply by having conversations with people. This early exposure to performance-based earning made her realize she could earn based on skill and performance rather than being tied to a degree, office, and set hours, which sparked her entrepreneurial ambitions.

4cc9c63b75.q: How did Ella Wood find her business partners Alex and Audrey to co-found New World Sales?
4cc9c63b75.a: Ella Wood met her business partners Alex and Audrey on Discord, an app typically used by gamers and business communities. They were both in a business community together, and they had a software company at the time. Ella initially hired them to help develop an app, but this collaboration evolved into the creation of New World Sales, though this wasn't her original plan.
